concerns.text: Tasks T054-T058 (GPU Fallback) have no matching FR/SC in spec.md. Spec FR-007 mandates 'CPU-only environment' and SC-005 requires completion on 'CPU-only CI runner'. The plan explicitly states 'No GPU/CUDA'. These tasks implement a feature (GPU execution) that contradicts the spec's core constraints and has no requirement anchor.

Tasks T059-T064 (Data Integrity & Streaming) are not explicitly anchored to any FR/SC or Plan element. While they address 'Fail Loudly' and 'Real Data Only' principles, there is no specific FR (e.g., 'System MUST fail on fetch error') or SC in the spec that these tasks satisfy. They appear to be implementation heuristics rather than requirement-driven tasks.

Tasks T039a-c (Profiling/Optimal Batch Size) lack a direct FR/SC anchor. Spec FR-002 fixes batch size at 8. While optimization is good engineering, there is no requirement in the spec or plan that mandates 'determining an optimal batch size' or 'updating config based on profiling'. This risks scope creep or implementing a feature not requested by the spec.

The tasks list includes T019 and T020 (marked [X] in the text) which the Analyze Report explicitly states were 'REJECTED' and their logic merged into T014. These tasks are 'stale tags' referencing work that was explicitly removed/merged. They should be deleted to prevent confusion, as they reference non-existent or merged logic.

Tasks T051a/T052a mandate 'dynamic INT8 quantization'. Spec Assumptions state the model 'can be loaded... without requiring 8-bit quantization'. While the Plan mentions 'no 8-bit quantization' in constraints, the tasks implement a specific mitigation (quantization) that contradicts the spec's assumption of default precision. There is no FR/SC that explicitly *requires* quantization; it is an implementation choice that conflicts with the spec's stated assumptions.
